followupSourceDiscovery.sourceTitle: Freshwater Shrimp Diversity and its Correlation to Water Properties in Selected Sites of Cañas River in Cavite, Philippines
followupSourceDiscovery.discoveryBasis: The official CvSU Research Journal July–December 2022 article cites a 2017 Cavite State University bachelor's thesis by Angelica T. Erce and A.M. Quiñones titled Identification of fish and crustacean species and water quality assessment of Cañas River watershed, Cavite, Philippines.
followupSourceDiscovery.interpretation: The official CvSU 2022 bibliography confirms a separate 2017 undergraduate fish-and-crustacean thesis. A 2026-11-01 correction to the author-profile crosswalk establishes that the fish-paper title is listed only at the 2019 ISSAAS Philippines National Congress; the profile’s 2017 PNEE listings are distinct Balsahan/Kay-Alamang water-quality and Cañas plankton works. The thesis and congress presentation are not proven to contain identical data.

nextAction: Seek authorized access to thesis pages 24-45 and appendix station figures on pages 80-85; confirm external-request eligibility and item-specific reuse. Keep the 2019 congress presentation as a bibliographic lead unless its abstract/proceedings and evidence become available.

libraryAccessReview.officialProcedure: Search the exact thesis title or subject in the CvSU E-Library; submit the CvSU Thesis Abstract Form; wait for library staff email that the abstract is available for download.
libraryAccessReview.searchAttempt: Bounded web-index searches for the exact title and authors did not surface the target thesis record. A direct OPAC search request timed out. These failures do not establish that the thesis is absent from the catalog.
libraryAccessReview.adjacentRecord: The CvSU library index exposes a separate 2017 Cañas plankton-and-water-quality thesis; it is not the cited fish-and-crustacean thesis and contributes no fish names.
libraryAccessReview.eligibilityForIndependentExternalRequest: Not verified; confirm with the library before submission.
